ac:layout-cell.h1: E-Invoice Retrieval API Reuse and Spain Changes
ac:layout-cell.p: Summary and walkthrough · Required behaviour · Sequences, product impact and gates
Confluence views: Summary · Required behaviour · Sequences and reuse · API reference

View and user download are required for all enabled public and private platforms, including the Sage offering. SPEC026 §1 owns this decision. A private provider's source-file fetch can still be necessary for intake and viewing. It is separate from a user downloading a saved file. REF-SCOPE.

This reference follows the onboarding API analysis: existing calls, request/result fields, Spain changes and open evidence. SPEC027 owns RET-G01–10 and the reuse decisions. This page does not create another gate register.

Evidence reviewed: INT-RCV01, INT-ERR01 and the supplied Query/Retrieve OpenAPI definitions (INT-RCV02/03, current user-supplied snapshots received 13 November 2026; earlier snapshots received 2 November are preserved), the SPFE catalogue/formats and the four original query/download WSDLs selected by the manifest: PRE release 29 October 2026. A canonical guide URL and deployed-build version remain missing. The supplied REST contracts do not prove Spain support. The WSDLs establish transport, not complete business schemas or a running Spain integration. REF-EVIDENCE.

Grey: documented existing calls/fields. · Blue: proposed Spain reuse or additional work. · Red: open evidence. Examples use synthetic IDs and placeholders. Response snippets are field extracts, not complete schemas or executed requests. INT-RCV02/03 list production and sandbox servers; no Spain environment is qualified by their presence.

ERP calls the Domain Service – E-Invoice Service through the existing E-Invoice API. Query supplies the business’s authorised sent/received list. Retrieve supplies one invoice’s details, history, attachment count and links when attachments are included. Downloading an attachment follows its returned link as part of the retrieval flow. These are two Sage invoice operations; the file transfer uses a further HTTP request to the returned URL.

tr.td: Open or filter the invoice list
datasetId, optional filter and page[after] → paginated data[], invoice information, current status, availableAttachments and file links. No status history is declared. INT-RCV02.
Open one selected invoice and access its attachments

datasetId and one e-invoiceId UUID → one data object, invoice details, current status, history[] including operation results/error codes, and availableAttachments. includeAttachments defaults to true; when false, descriptors and URLs are omitted. Follow an included link to obtain the file. INT-RCV03; INT-RCV01 §4.

ac:layout-cell.p: The usual screen flow is Query → select invoice → Retrieve → follow an attachment link if needed. RET-API-03 retains the file-transfer rules under their existing ID; it does not define a third Sage invoice endpoint. A caller that already has a qualified invoice ID can retrieve directly. Query already includes invoice information and file links; a detail call is needed only when the caller needs additional information or a renewed link. Qualify the list-to-detail ID mapping below before using it. INT-RCV02/03; RET-G01/04.

tr.td: Supply invoices for the required public/private list view; recover missed notifications within qualified query coverage.
Sent/received selection for customer views, inbound filters for event recovery, business mapping and historical coverage. RET-G01/03.
SPEC026 §2; RSD-03; RRI-A04
Supply selected invoice information, status/history and file descriptors.
Public/private support, source identity and role mapping. Metadata alone is not a readable document. RET-G01/04/07.
SPEC026 §2; RSD-07; RCV-02
Obtain bytes using a link returned by Retrieve or Query; assess reuse for public/private user download from saved files.
Prove that the link returns the selected captured file under current authority. Private download coverage also needs qualification. RET-G04/05/10.
Accelerate discovery where supported. Required view does not depend on webhook availability.
Selected source/environment, permissions, event contract and missed-event recovery. RET-G02/03.
Assess an optional readable representation.
Factur-X generation is not selected by the required view outcome. Spain need and existing rendering options remain RET-G08.
RRI-A06; RCV-I05

ac:layout-cell.p: Resolve datasetId from the qualified SXS/onboarding binding. Keep the business, caller, source and environment explicit. Obtain invoice IDs from qualified list/event results. Neither a known ID nor an existing connection grants permission. Onboarding GAP-01/02/06 remains authoritative for setup/resource relationships. Do not create another dataset or connection to read an invoice. REF-TERMS.

View invoice list, Select and open invoice and Download file in the SPEC026 detailed process map to Query, Retrieve and file transfer below; Receive invoice has its own source/intake flow. Review and take action branches from the opened invoice and uses SPEC029’s decision journey and SPEC041’s lifecycle commands. Query and Retrieve do not submit decisions.

The SPEC026 §2 customer journey uses the existing calls below. The customer or accountant chooses the action; ERP calls the Domain Service through the shared API and displays its response. This names the logical service boundary, not another endpoint or a proven deployment.

tr.td: Query / RET-API-01 returns permitted sent/received results and paging.
Keep the business, source and qualified paging context. An empty result does not prove collection succeeded.
Retrieve / RET-API-02 returns detail, history, attachment count and descriptors if included.
Recheck access and qualify the list-to-detail ID under RET-G01. Metadata alone does not render a readable invoice.
Use a returned link; request links through Retrieve if omitted or expired. RET-API-03 transfers bytes from the file source.
Recheck current file access, role, safety and integrity. Do not auto-download on opening.

ac:layout-cell.p: This journey does not remove the documented ability to open a known qualified ID or use a file link returned by Query. No new endpoint is selected.

Reuse the NIF, certificate/authority setup and authorised business/dataset/environment binding from onboarding. Neither GET declares NIF or certificate parameters, and the new legal-address fields do not prove Spain address support. INT-RCV02/03 declare Sage ID M2M bearer JWT authentication for both GETs. traceparent and tracestate are optional; neither GET declares Idempotency-Key. INT-RCV01 permits Domain Services or Sage ID M2M tokens in its introduction but describes Network-token login in the subscription table. Confirm accepted caller/token scope per operation and resolve guide differences; do not copy subscription headers to GETs. RET-G01/02.

For 429, honour valid Retry-After; no fixed quota or polling interval is supplied. Preserve history operationStatus values IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, ERROR. Read the correlated attempt's history[].errorCode; currentStatus has neither field. A final attempt error is not a failed business invoice or an instruction to recapture. Keep the code-specific platform retry/support owner from INT-ERR01. RET-G02/09.
Keep these source lists separate. A document type, an API classification and a status do not identify the same concept. Do not infer an allowed customer action from one of these values.

Existing API invoice classification — exact eInvoiceTypeCode enum. INT-RCV02 InvoicesResponse.properties.documents.items.properties.eInvoiceTypeCode; INT-RCV03 InvoiceResponse.properties.eInvoiceTypeCode.

ac:layout-cell.p: Do not replace 384 or 471 with France credit-note code 381. SPFE-S08 §5.1.1 p. 8 selects UBL 2.5 InvoiceType, including rectification. This source list does not qualify the mapping to the four API values above or the UI action rules.

p.strong: Status and command lists — authoritative owners:

tr.th: Exact values / how to use it

tr.td: SPEC029 SPFE states and reporting classifications; draft platform mapping

Owns the business meanings, reporting requirements and proposed relationships. Approved, Refused and technical Rejected remain distinct outcomes. Exact catalogue codes and UUIDs stay in the source/API references below; the draft does not prove Spain support. INT-LCS03/04.
INT-LCS03 exact catalogue UUIDs; SPEC041 documented command inputs
A lifecycle POST statusCode takes a UUID, not numeric 205 or 210. A catalogue entry is not proof of a writable command or a permitted transition.
Complete eight-code list from SPFE-S02 Annex II. Recipient REJECTION and PAYMENT are separate from issuer events and cancellation reports. No explicit public acceptance code is supplied.
INT-RCV03 invoiceHistoryItem.operationStatus
Exact enum: IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, ERROR. It describes an attempt, not the invoice’s commercial status or completion of all required reports.

ac:layout-cell.p: Source conflict to resolve: the Query/Retrieve examples label UUID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-100000000001 as New; INT-LCS03 assigns New UUID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-170000000000. Keep returned IDs and source context. Do not repair the sample or use it as a command fixture. API/Lifecycle owners must qualify the selected build’s catalogue under RET-G01 and LIF-G03 before enabling actions. The original Sage guide URL is recorded in SPEC029 REF; live access was unavailable during this review, so the supplied guide extract remains the evidence limit.
GET /datasets/{datasetId}/e-invoices · INT-RCV02; INT-RCV01 §3.2.

tr.td: Request

Required datasetId; optional OData filter and page[after]. INT-RCV02 examples cover erpInvoiceId, createdAt, customizationId, recipient/accessPointAddress, recipient/accessPointAddressLegal, availableAttachments and currentStatus/statusCode. Additional guide filters and conflicting dot/slash examples need runtime qualification.
Response

200; data[] with attributes.documents[]. Each document can contain eInvoiceId, parties including accessPointAddressLegal, totals, current status, availableAttachments and attachments[].downloadUrl. No history[] is declared. The older guide list example omits URLs; that omission does not require a detail call before every download. INT-RCV02 GetInvoicesResponse / InvoicesResponse.
Page / range

meta.count, meta.hasMore, links.self, links.next are in INT-RCV02. Up to 20 items/page and a 90-day creation window are guide statements, not specified limits in the supplied OpenAPI. Qualify them against the selected build. Neither establishes retention or complete historical coverage.
Invoice identity

The list example has different outer data[].id and nested documents[].eInvoiceId values. Neither contract explains this relationship. Confirm which value binds the detail path and how multiple documents map to the list before activation. RET-G01.
Direction
Both sent and received codes can appear. Qualify AP_Invoice, AR_Invoice, AP_CreditNote, AR_CreditNote, self-billing and the selected source. Do not present every dataset result as received.

p.strong: Request — documented path, synthetic dataset ID:

p.span: Reuse for the public/private list view; preserve the returned invoice IDs and source context. Supply SPFE freshness/collection results through a qualified existing or extended product contract.

The guide does not define that freshness contract, stable ordering, snapshot behaviour, continuation expiry or older-than-90-day access. Do not infer an empty complete history from this call. RET-G01/03/05.

ac:layout-cell.p: GET /datasets/{datasetId}/e-invoices/{e-invoiceId} · UUID path parameters · INT-RCV03; INT-RCV01 §3.1.

tr.td: INT-RCV03 declares one data object with id; invoice fields sit directly in data.attributes. The older guide field table also lists data.attributes.eInvoiceId; the supplied detail schema does not. Resolve the Query document-ID mapping under RET-G01.
eInvoiceTypeCode, sender, recipient, accessPointId, erpInvoiceId
Invoice type, parties and source/product references. erpInvoiceId is not a universal duplicate key.
currentStatus, history[], data.meta

INT-RCV03 adds currentStatus.statusAttributes and declares history fields operationStatus, errorCode, statusAttributes and attempt metadata. data.meta is required. Neither history ordering nor full attempt correlation is supplied. Viewing does not create buyer acceptance.
Request option

includeAttachments is an inline boolean query parameter, default true. false omits attachments, skips URL generation and skips Factur-X generation even if format=facturx is present. It does not suppress invoice details/history or availableAttachments. INT-RCV03.
Attachment count

availableAttachments is an integer ≥ 0. With includeAttachments=false, a positive count can accompany omitted descriptors. This does not prove missing files or return a file identity. An absent count is not a reported zero.
Legal addresses

sender.accessPointAddressLegal and recipient.accessPointAddressLegal are extracted legal-format endpoint values. Spain NIF/address mapping remains RET-G01; the supplied address-type enums still use France values.
File descriptors

Descriptors, when returned, contain filename, mimetype, filetype, downloadUrl. includeAttachments=false omits them. INT-RCV03 includes Undefined, UBL, Human_Readable, Original_Document, FacturX; map these values to saved business file roles.
Tax detail
VAT totals and tax breakdowns are not exposed as extracted fields in the guide. Use the qualified structured representation and inbound mapping where the product view needs them. RET-G07.

p.strong: Details without attachment links — documented option:

ac:layout-cell.p: To obtain links after this request, repeat Retrieve with includeAttachments=true or omit that parameter. Use the selected invoice context and current permission. A zero count means no attachment is reported as available; keep the unavailable-file outcome separate from omitted descriptors.

p.strong: Response 200 — one included attachment descriptor extract; container/schema not asserted:

ac:layout-cell.p: The MIME string above is a guide example, not the Spain public format. Qualify public UBL 2.5 and the original/public-copy/derived mapping. Use detail information to build the required view for both source types. A detail GET supplies data and links; it does not prove document rendering, saved-record storage or Spain service support. RET-G01/04/05/07.
GET {downloadUrl} · INT-RCV01 §4.

This step follows an attachment link returned by Retrieve or Query. If Retrieve omitted attachments, request includeAttachments=true first. availableAttachments alone is not a download link. The existing ID records transfer and recovery rules; the supplied OpenAPI definitions do not define a separate Sage attachment-download endpoint. The Retrieve response is JSON with links; following a link returns the actual file.

200 returns bytes. The guide says the URL is short-lived and presigned; send no Authorization header to the file host. Capture bytes promptly. Do not retain the URL in durable records, logs or events. An expired link can return 403; only confirmed expiry justifies reading detail again for a fresh link. Other refusals need their own cause/action.

p.span: For public/private user download, reuse this call only if it returns the selected captured file with current actor/file permission, correct role and integrity. Preserve good files when a required file is missing. Keep ordinary saved reads independent of source-platform availability and downstream mapping/product receipt.

The guide does not establish immutable attachment identity/version/hash, allowed host/redirect rules, byte-range resume, storage ownership or historical saved-read access. A presigned link alone does not close these gaps. Identify an existing records contract before proposing an endpoint extension. Required user download and backend source-file acquisition need separate qualification. RET-G04/05/10.

ac:layout-cell.h3: 1.4 RET-API-04 — Subscribe and receive an event
ac:layout-cell.p: POST /internal/events/subscriptions → 201 · INT-RCV01 §§1–2. The guide labels the result 201 OK; only code 201 is retained here.

tr.td: Scope
Resource einvoice, event e-invoicing.einvoice.received, accountId, datasetId, selected source/environment and optional OData filter. Do not copy France source sage.pdp.france to Spain.
Callback
audience, endpoint, endpointType: https, optional opaqueToken and clientstate (maximum 256 characters). Caller access and notification authentication remain unqualified.
Event

subject supplies the invoice ID; context includes id, subscriptionid, accountid, datasetid, source, time, traceparent and nullable data.errorCode. Verify scope/authenticity and errors before detail retrieval.
Source conflicts
Request Data/Type/Attributes/Scope versus lowercase; opaqueToken versus opaquetoken; subscription event name differs from notification example com.sage.network.e-invoicing.api.einvoice.received.

ac:layout-cell.p: No safe complete subscription payload, webhook response deadline, replay contract or versioned event schema can be selected from these conflicts. Obtain the Events Library and selected schema. A public SPFE webhook is not established. RET-G02. Notification receipt does not prove source capture or authorize a destructive source acknowledgement. RRI-A02/04/09.
GET /datasets/{datasetId}/e-invoices/{e-invoiceId}?format=facturx · INT-RCV03 parameters.format; INT-RCV01 §§3.1/4.

INT-RCV03 says format=facturx generates and persists a Factur-X/ZUGFeRD 2.3 hybrid from UBL/PDF attachments, or returns an existing FacturX attachment without regeneration. INT-RCV01 describes Human_Readable; confirm the selected build's file-role mapping. With includeAttachments=false, the current contract skips that generation and URL creation, still returning the attachment count. This is a derived representation. The supplier's Factur-X can separately be Original_Document; returned UBL is not necessarily the supplier's original bytes.

p.span: Required invoice viewing can reuse qualified product detail displays or readable representations.

Do not select this France generation option as the Spain viewer by default. Confirm actual renderer/build, required content, unsupported formats and independent rendering errors under RET-G08. Ordinary detail/saved-file access does not request generation.

ac:layout-cell.p: These backend SPFE SOAP operations support RSD-03 discovery/source acquisition and RSD-04–06 capture/progress. Each uses HTTP POST at the selected WSDL service address. The catalogue establishes business purpose and limits; missing formats remain open. Keep QUERYBYFILTER and other ebMS actions separate from HTTP soapAction URIs. SPFE-S03/S08/S12–15.

The supplied SPFE baseline establishes no webhook or WebSocket interface. These operations require Sage-initiated calls. Product-facing Query/Retrieve calls do not define a trigger for fresh SPFE collection. SPEC027 §3.1 owns the France comparison, scheduled baseline, proposed list-open refresh and Architecture's cadence/rate-limit decisions. REF-EVIDENCE; RET-G03/06.

tr.td: RET-SPFE-01 — GetRegisteredInvoice
QUERYBYFILTER: recipient/issuer role and presentation-date filters in MessageProperties → DocumentStatus; maximum 1000 results, pagination key SECUENCE_ID.
Exact property names/types, date boundaries, ordering, complete continuation and recipient authority. The singular operation name is exact.
RET-SPFE-02 — GetInvoices
QUERYBYID: role and invoice identities → invoice metadata/final issuer/recipient states in DocumentStatus; maximum 1000 identifiers.
Identity encoding and response mapping. This is not date discovery, a source file or a full lifecycle-history contract.
RET-SPFE-03 — DownloadInvoicesByLOC
DOWNLOADBYLOC: one ApplicationResponse with locator-based DocumentReference entries → InvoiceType files. Catalogue prefers this route.
Locator/NIU encoding and certificate/representation checks. No LOC batch limit is supplied; do not copy the ID limit.
RET-SPFE-04 — DownloadInvoicesByID
DOWNLOADBYID: one ApplicationResponse with invoice DocumentReference entries → InvoiceType files; maximum 100 invoices. Failed references have distinct errors.
Exact ID/role binding, item/file correlation, partial outcomes and read effects. The ID is issuer NIF + series/number + issue date, not a Sage UUID.

ac:layout-cell.p: SPFE-S12–15 define certificate ports under https://prewww1.aeat.es/wlpl/SPFE-FACT/ws/ and seal ports under https://prewww10.aeat.es/wlpl/SPFE-FACT/ws/. Append the exact suffix below. These are supplied PRE addresses; neither runtime access nor a production address is qualified.

Use SOAP 1.2, an empty SOAP body and eb3:Messaging in the header. The SOAP part uses application/soap+xml with action equal to the selected soapAction. With attachments, it sits in multipart/related, type="application/soap+xml". Match each PartInfo/@href="cid:..." to its MIME Content-ID; the WSDL declares no generic payload part. Zero-to-many transport attachments do not override operation-specific business minima/limits. SPFE-S12–15; SPEC011 transport rules.

Standard SOAP 1.2 faults use env:Code/env:Value and env:Reason/env:Text, no service-specific env:Detail, HTTP 400 or 500. Catalogue download-error wording and business result levels still need reconciliation. Do not use removed custom fault fields or treat HTTP success as proof that every requested file was captured. RET-G06; SPFE-S03/S08/S12–15.
Spain file-role classification uses SPEC026’s public UBL copy-indicator table. Keep that field separate from attachment filetype values and from evidence that two representations match.

SPFE-S08 §§5.4–5.7 mark query/download formats pending. The WSDLs treat business attachments as opaque; they do not define the missing filter names, full DocumentReference structure, locator encoding, item-error payloads or continuation guarantees. Therefore this reference supplies no executable XML business payload. Obtain the original business schemas/examples and qualify them before enabling collection. RET-G06.

For recipient work, check representation separately from certificate validity. Issuer/social-collaborator and locator/certificate branches cannot be reused as proof of recipient permission. Qualify the selected role and operation before making calls. RSD-R01; SPFE-S02 Articles 9–11; SPFE-S03 §§6.4–6.7.

tr.td: Public/private invoice view
Prefer existing E-Invoice list/detail and product display capabilities. Add only missing Spain source/role/freshness bindings.
API, Product, Identity: selected build/schema, authorised same-environment examples and historical-view coverage. RET-G01/03/05.
Public/private user download
Prefer existing file/records capability. Prove that selected links return captured, labelled files under current authority.
Records, API, Security: actual build, saved-file binding, restore/history and access evidence. RET-G04/05.
Private provider coverage
Prove required saved-file download for each enabled external provider and the Sage offering. A backend provider fetch alone does not establish user access.
Records, API and provider owners, with Product/Compliance: selected contracts/builds, file roles, permissions and failure recovery. RET-G10.
Public collection
Reuse the shared capture/progress/recovery design, with the qualified Spain SOAP binding. Actual implementation reuse remains unknown.
Connector/API/Identity: current client build, missing business contracts, authority, partial results and recovery proof. RET-G06.
Private intake
Prefer proven notification/fetch or supplied-file handling. Product-facing RET-API calls do not establish a provider-owned download contract.
Integration/provider: selected provider operation, bytes/role provenance, authority and acknowledgement/history. RET-G01/02/04.
Format conversion / readable display
Follow SPEC026 RCV-06 for DTS conversion. Readable display is a separate capability; UBL 2.5 viewing does not require DTS conversion.
Format/Product: prove display support. For Phase 3 non-UBL 2.5 input, DTS proves the selected conversion, build, field preservation and recovery. RET-G07/08; REF-DTS-SCOPE.

ac:layout-cell.p: No source establishes a new product view, freshness, refresh, saved-read or rendering endpoint. Architecture/API owners must identify existing coverage, then specify only the required extension. Demonstrate country-rule isolation and existing-country compatibility; Spain identity, public-copy, authority and UBL rules must not become shared defaults. SPEC027 RET-API-A01–10 owns qualification acceptance.

The REST snapshot register records current and preserved earlier hashes. The source comparison identifies the 13 November additions. Both supplied files still declare info.version: 1.0.0; publication date and deployed build remain unknown.
